steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Engineering creates both positive and negative impacts on society, the economy and the environment.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Positive social impacts: improved infrastructure, medical devices, communication technology and housing.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Negative social impacts: noise pollution, traffic congestion, community displacement and digital divide.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Positive economic impacts: job creation, export revenue, technology spin-offs and improved productivity.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Give two positive and two negative social impacts of building a new motorway. | Q: Explain how engineering can both cause and help solve environmental problems. | Q: What is CSR and why is it important for engineering companies?

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: In impact questions, always give BOTH positive AND negative impacts - one-sided answers lose marks. Categorise impacts: social (people), economic (money/jobs), environmental (planet). Use specific examples rather than vague statements. Link CSR and sustainability to commercial benefits, not just ethics. In ethical questions, reference the professional duty of engineers to protect public safety.
